title: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
abstract: arXiv:2610.33817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points

translated_title: EnvLunch：环境作为学习交互的免费午餐
translated_abstract: 对于智能体式数据分析而言，语言模型智能体通常需要大量标注任务来学习如何与可执行环境（即数据库）进行有效交互。虽然高质量的标注任务需要大量的人工投入，但可执行环境本身已经提供了丰富的交互结构和可验证的结果。从这个意义上说，环境本身提供了一份免费午餐——一组无需人工标注的可验证任务。我们提出了 EnvLunch，这是一个预热阶段，它将这种环境信号转化为智能体训练，而无需人工编写或模型生成的任务描述，可应用于下游的智能体强化学习之前。EnvLunch 采样有效的动作轨迹，执行这些轨迹以获得最终观察结果，然后训练智能体在仅给定最终观察结果的情况下恢复出功能等效的轨迹。这种无标签的预热方法使模型的性能超越基线 9 个百分点以上。
tldr: EnvLunch 提出了一种无需人工标注的预热方法，通过让智能体仅凭最终观察结果恢复功能等效的动作轨迹，将可执行环境自身的信号免费转化为训练资源，使模型在下游智能体强化学习中超越基线 9 个百分点以上。
en_tdlr: EnvLunch introduces a label-free warm-up stage that trains agents to recover functionally equivalent trajectories from final observations alone, turning the executable environment itself into a free source of verifiable training tasks and outperforming the baseline by over 9 points before downstream agentic reinforcement learning.
